'''Ores''' in Matcha Flavoured are mostly renamed vanilla ores, some with new drops or generation. Emerald ore becomes [[Native Silver|native silver]], lapis ore splits into [[Quartz Deposit|quartz deposits]] and [[Natural Lapis Lazuli|natural lapis lazuli]], and redstone ore becomes [[Sulfurous Quartz Deposit|sulfurous quartz deposit]]. Adamant tools smelt the drops of several ores (see the table); electrum tools add Fortune.
